9.1.name: JAM.ServiceId

9.3.name: JAM.ServiceAccount
9.3.note: 𝐬 and 𝐥 share `entries`, keyed by state-key hashes; a_i and a_o are the carried fields `items` and `octets`

9.6.reason: the invariant is not a property of `JAM.ServiceAccount`, and no theorem yet states that the transitions changing 𝐩 and 𝐥 preserve it

9.7.name: JAM.ServiceAccount.historicalLookup

9.8.note: a_i and a_o are the carried fields `items` and `octets`, updated by `storageWrite`, `requestSet` and `requestErase`; that they equal the paper's sums is not yet a theorem
